description:
Transaction Lookup: full details by hash on Ethereum mainnet. Returns full Ethereum transaction details by hash via eth_getTransactionByHash on Ethereum mainnet.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_eth_gettransactionbyhash. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
